title: Replay child account deletion through the authenticated native admin route
classification: Confirmed route-level verification gap closed for current schema.

scenario.actor: Active admin with a valid test session and CSRF token.
scenario.target: Child-role account with a retained audit event containing the child's name, email, and an absolute local path.
scenario.route: DELETE /admin/api/user/{user_id} through the native FastAPI admin router and AdminUserMutationData adapter.

result.account: The child user row is absent after the request.
result.audit: The audit row remains with a null author reference and without the child's name, email, or absolute path.

verification.database: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL 17.6 database upgraded through Alembic head e1f2a3b4c5d6; database dropped after the run.
verification.command: uv run --python <Python-3.12.16-path> --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt pytest tests/test_native_admin_user_mutations.py tests/test_admin_user_delete_retention.py -q
includes: The new authenticated native-route child deletion and audit anonymization replay.
The Flask admin-route child deletion and audit retention replay.
Existing deletion relation, failure-injection, retry, and file-cleanup regressions in the two focused modules.

limits: This verifies application behavior against a fresh current schema; no deployed database was read or changed.
